tail: Photorealistic photograph for a practical home laundry how-to video. Bright, tidy laundry room with a white front-loading washing machine and a white utility sink, light wood countertop and white walls, soft daylight. Adult hands, rolled-up sleeves of a light blue denim shirt, no face visible. 16:9 landscape format. No text, no letters, no numbers, no brand names, no logos, no watermark.
